messages:
talia: Hi everyone  Day 1 quicks: MDM installer on my Mac hangs at 'Installing profile' and never finishes. VPN keeps popping the Okta auth loop (enter creds repeatedly). I also need KMS read for a demo (brief, staging only)  where do I request? Saw a phish-sim invite but no schedule. Who do I ping for each?

people-ops: Welcome @talia! Tagging IT and Security. If you want a company laptop instead of BYOD we can start provisioning.

it-support: Hey @talia 1 For the MDM hang try: 1) remove any old profiles (System Settings  Profiles) 2) reboot 3) reinstall. If it still hangs, collect this and paste here: `log show --predicate 'subsystem CONTAINS "mdm"' --last 30m | tail -n 60`. For the Okta loop, open Okta in a browser and approve the device prompt, then try VPN. If that doesn't help, run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `scutil --proxy` and paste output. We can also start a remote screen-share.

security: KMS requests go through the key-request form: https://redwood.example/internal/key-requests. For staging-only demos we often grant ephemeral kms:read via the Dev Portal (https://devtools.redwood.internal/ephemeral) while the ticket is reviewed. Phish-sim runs for 14 days from invite and emails come from training@phishsim.io  check spam. FileVault required only if you store prod creds locally; BYOD attestation + signed form works for staging-only.

security-bot: Reminder: SEC101 due in 7 days: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/sec101. Phish-sim FAQ: https://redwood.example/internal/phishsim-faq.

talia: Thanks  I removed old profiles, rebooted; installer still stuck so I grabbed logs and filed a key-request for the demo (KR-3077). Pasting the MDM log excerpt: "MDM: profile install stalled at Applying manifest". KR-3077 has manager note. Can security expedite?

it-support: Got the log snippet 1 Looks like a policy mismatch. Try `sudo profiles -R -p com.redwood.mdm` then reinstall. If that fails we'll remote in.

security: KR-3077 received, marking expedite and issuing ephemeral kms:read for 2 hours. You should get an email with instructions in ~10m. Welcome aboard  ping this thread if anything blocks the first day.
